stemMd: Myelin around a vertebrate axon primarily increases conduction speed by which mechanism?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Making the resting membrane potential permanently zero

options.label: B
options.textMd: Causing neurotransmitter to diffuse along the entire axon exterior

options.label: C
options.textMd: Turning the axon into a blood vessel

options.label: D
options.textMd: Allowing action potentials to be regenerated mainly at nodes of Ranvier

options.label: E
options.textMd: Removing every ion channel from the axon

explanationMd: Myelin insulates internodal regions, so local current spreads rapidly and action potentials are regenerated at nodes. This saltatory conduction differs from neurotransmitter release across a synapse.

distractorRationale.c: Myelin does not change cell identity.
distractorRationale.b: Electrical propagation differs from synaptic chemical diffusion.
distractorRationale.a: That would not support normal action potentials.
